features.title: Internal management origin and host compatibility
features.summary: Preserve private host-call routing and public plugin identity/assets.
invariants: Use internal management_origin behind browser access gates; do not persist access tokens, management keys or invite secrets.
Keep codex-invite source/version/archive identity and C ABI/JSON compatibility with the host.
verification: Manual: target-platform library packaging and host C ABI/JSON compatibility; source tests do not verify a production binary.

dependencies.contract: Build against the documented host target; validate C ABI/JSON ownership and protocol separately from Go SDK source consumers.
